assets.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup.
Asset type: an AI-generated cake inspiration photograph for a premium bespoke bakery website, a standalone image rather than a collage.
Primary request: a beautifully handcrafted TWO-TIER jungle birthday cake in pastel sage green and warm ivory, featuring charming realistic edible fondant elephant, giraffe and lion figures, delicate edible botanical leaves and carefully sculpted foliage. The cake should feel boutique, exquisite and believable rather than cartoonish or mass produced.
Scene/backdrop: warm ivory plaster wall, pale beige stone table or low stone plinth, minimal quiet studio setting.
Composition/framing: portrait 2:3 at the highest native resolution; the entire cake, every topper and full elegant cake stand must fit comfortably inside the frame. Leave generous breathing room above, below and on both sides for responsive crops. Cake occupies about 65% of frame height. Camera at cake level with a subtle three-quarter view. Crisp focus on the entire cake front to back with sharp, detailed edges.
Lighting/mood: soft directional daylight entering from the left, subtle realistic contact shadows, refined high-end food editorial photography with warm natural colour, no harsh highlights.
Color palette: restrained ivory, pale sage, muted blush accents, small natural warm-gold details.
Materials/textures: visible edible frosting texture, delicate matte fondant, tiny hand-shaped details, natural cake imperfections conveying craftsmanship. Photograph of a real edible cake, never plastic or glossy CGI.
Constraints: ONE standalone cake photograph only. No people, hands, licensed characters, lettering, text, names, numbers, logos or watermark. No collage, no split frame, no graphic overlays.
